zh: 杜克大学（Duke University）成立于1838年，位于美国北卡罗来纳州达勒姆市，是世界顶尖的私立研究型大学。学校在医学、法学、商学、公共政策、工程等领域享有盛誉，其学术研究水平位居世界前列。杜克大学以其优秀的教学质量和丰富的体育传统著称，培养了大量各领域的杰出人才。
en: Duke University, founded in 1838, is a world-leading private research university in Durham, North Carolina. It excels in medicine, law, business, public policy, engineering, and more, with world-leading academic research. Known for its excellent teaching quality and rich athletic tradition, Duke University has produced numerous talents across fields.
